tasks.agent:build: cd agent && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -trimpath -ldflags "-X main.version=0.1.0-dev" -o ../server/data/downloads/gsm-agent/0.1.0-dev/x86_64 ./cmd/gsm-agent && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 go build -trimpath -ldflags "-X main.version=0.1.0-dev" -o ../server/data/downloads/gsm-agent/0.1.0-dev/aarch64 ./cmd/gsm-agent
tasks.test: SESSION_SECRET=test-only-secret-test-only-secret-0000 deno test -A shared/tests server/tests && cd agent && go test ./...
tasks.dev: deno task dev:server & deno task dev:web; wait
tasks.images:build: docker build -t ghcr.io/ionnet-dev/gsm-base:latest images/base && for v in 8 17 21 25; do docker build --build-arg JAVA_VERSION=$v -t ghcr.io/ionnet-dev/gsm-java:$v images/java; done
